name: 🐎Horse RNG
desc:
🐴 Welcome to Horse RNG 🐴 

Buy food from the shop, breed your horses, unlock unique & rare breeds, and then sell or race them to make money! 

How to Breed Horses:
- Buy Food with a High Enough Level
- Feed the Two Horses You Want To Breed
- Wait for the Baby Horse to Grow Up
- Sell it or put it on the podium at the front of your plot to make it your race horse!

Your horses literally grow up while you're offline!
